intro.label: OCD CHECK-IN
intro.headline: Understand your OCD patterns
intro.supporting: A quick check-in to help you notice what's been showing up lately.

instruction: Reflect on how this has felt over the past few weeks:

questions.ocd_q1: How often do unwanted thoughts, doubts, or images pop into your mind and feel difficult to dismiss?
questions.ocd_q2: How strong is the urge to get complete 100% certainty or reassurance when a doubt arises?
questions.ocd_q3: How often do you feel driven to repeat physical actions (such as checking locks/appliances, washing, arranging, or repeating steps) until it feels right?
questions.ocd_q4: How often do you perform mental rituals (such as replaying past events, silent counting, mentally reviewing conversations, or replacing bad thoughts with good ones)?
questions.ocd_q5: How much distress, anxiety, or internal discomfort do you experience when these thoughts or doubts occur?
questions.ocd_q6: How difficult is it to resist performing a behavior or mental ritual when the urge strikes?
questions.ocd_q7: How much time or mental attention do these thoughts and repetitive rituals consume during your day?
questions.ocd_q8: How much do these patterns interfere with your work, studies, relationships, sleep, or daily routines?

wizard.validation_error: Please answer all questions before viewing your summary.

report.score_explanation: Your score reflects your responses in this check-in. It is not a diagnosis.
report.range_lower_desc: Fewer symptoms and less day-to-day impact reported.
report.range_middle_desc: Some symptoms and noticeable impact reported.
report.range_higher_desc: More symptoms and meaningful impact reported.
report.summary_lowest: Your responses suggest that OCD-related symptoms and their impact are currently limited.
report.summary_middle: Your responses suggest that OCD-related symptoms and their impact may be taking some space in your day.
report.summary_elevated: Your responses suggest that OCD-related symptoms and their impact may be taking meaningful space in your day.
report.summary_low_journey: Keep exploring your OCDMantra pathway to learn more about OCD and how it can show up.
report.no_pattern_desc: Your responses did not point strongly toward one particular OCD-related pattern in this check-in.
report.domain_mental_rituals_desc: You reported mental strategies such as reviewing, checking, or seeking certainty.
report.domain_intrusive_thoughts_desc: You reported unwanted thoughts or doubts that can feel difficult to dismiss.
report.domain_compulsions_desc: You reported feeling driven to repeat physical actions or habits to relieve discomfort.
report.domain_functional_impact_desc: You reported that these patterns may be taking time, focus, or attention in your routine.
report.domain_distress_desc: You reported notable internal discomfort or urges that feel hard to step back from.
report.error_save: We could not save your activity completion right now. Your check-in summary is safe.
